hypothesis: Outcome-led wording that names a SPECIFIC, verifiable result (a number) converts better than feature-led wording, and better than the same outcome stated vaguely, especially among skeptical, price-sensitive people. Urgency/scarcity wording will backfire with skeptics.

success_criteria.label: Numeric outcome beats the vague outcome
Urgency ranks below numeric outcome for skeptical budget shoppers

A_feature.label: Feature-led
A_feature.text: PantryPilot scans your fridge with your phone camera and generates a 5-dinner weekly plan with a missing-items shopping list. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free filters included. $9/month.

B_outcome.label: Vague outcome
B_outcome.text: Stop throwing food away. Beta users of PantryPilot report wasting less food after 3 months, because every dinner is planned around what's already in your fridge. Try it free for 14 days, then $9/month.

B2_outcome_number.label: Numeric outcome
B2_outcome_number.text: Stop throwing food away. In our 12-week beta, 312 households estimated they wasted about 31% less food (self-reported survey). Every dinner is planned around what's already in your fridge. Try it free for 14 days, then $9/month.

C_social.label: Social proof
C_social.text: Join 312 beta households already planning dinners with PantryPilot. Scan your fridge, get 5 dinners in 30 minutes or less. First 14 days free.

D_urgency.label: Urgency
D_urgency.text: Last chance! Founding-member pricing of $9/month ends tonight. Don't waste another week of groceries - start PantryPilot now before the price goes up!
